in_sanskrit.name: Peehu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus Flower
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Peehu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Peehu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pushp' which means 'Flower' and 'Hu' which means 'Lotus'. The name signifies the beauty and grace of the Lotus flower. It is also believed to represent purity, peace and enlightenment.
